# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Feipiaei, ülkantueael, rafi antüle zeuma.
Wül zuiñun ta inche, Awem Nünechen, eimi mi tremumol, tami kimafiel, tami poieneael Mupiii, feula tami wezakoñañen, ka tami newen ñen, tañi kunifall ñen ka tami ulmen ñen. Eka ñelai Nünechen Eimi müten, Kellukelu ta kuütu meo, Kizu Moñen ñelu.
